title: Ferran Torres' Winning Goal Secures World Cup for Spain
summary: Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time to secure a 1-0 victory over Argentina and win the FIFA World Cup for Spain. The goal, which was assisted by Nico Williams, came in the 106th minute of extra time and proved decisive in the match. This marked Spain's first World Cup title since 2010.
summary_points: Ferran Torres scored a winning goal in extra time to secure a 1-0 victory over Argentina
The goal was assisted by Nico Williams
This marked Spain's first World Cup title since 2010
The match was played at the FIFA World Cup 2026
Argentina lost the match, while Spain won the championship
